scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node -e "import('fs').then(fs => { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('frontend/public/_redirects', 'dist/_redirects'); fs.mkdirSync('frontend/frontend/dist', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'frontend/frontend/dist', {recursive: true}); })"
